description: Make a food repeat automatically on chosen weekdays. food_id and measure_id come from search_foods (default_measure_id) or get_food_details; quantity is a count of that measure. The rule is saved and reads back, but which day Cronometer treats as weekday 0 is assumed (Sunday), so ask the user to check the rule in the Cronometer app. Not yet verified against a live account: after it succeeds, read the result back (get_diary or the matching read tool) and tell the user if it did not land as intended.

diary_group.description: Diary group 1–4 (by default Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Snacks).

food_id.description: A Cronometer id from an earlier tool result.

food_name.description: The food’s name, as search_foods returned it.

measure_id.description: A Cronometer id from an earlier tool result.

quantity.description: How many of the measure to add each time.

name: add_repeat_item
title: Add Repeated Food
